targets.name: Copper pot
targets.notes: The unmistakable copper vessel has a lid, visible body and tall right handle; the basket conceals its left side. The unrelated-looking curved arch above the basket has an obscured connection and is deliberately excluded rather than inferred to be a spout.

targets.name: Whisk
targets.notes: One wire whisk stands among wooden spoons, with its metal handle entering the cream utensil jar. Major openings between the wires are excluded from the exact region. The unchanged crop preserves the thin wires and the real background spoons.

targets.name: Fluted mould
targets.notes: A small silver fluted baking mould sits partly behind a wooden shelf/container lip. The annotation follows only the visible metal mould and excludes the wooden box beneath it.

targets.name: Mortar & pestle
targets.notes: A stone mortar and its pestle blend with the tan books; the leaning book naturally hides the left edge of the bowl. Both distinctive parts are visible.

targets.name: Yellow crock
targets.notes: A yellow lidded crock is tucked behind the wicker basket on the left and a hanging blue checked cloth on the right. Its dark knob, rounded lid and glazed body are visible; foreground basket and cloth are excluded.

targets.name: Gingham jam jar
targets.notes: A red gingham cloth and tied string distinguish this preserve jar from its amber and plain-lidded neighbors. The full jar, cloth and dangling twine are included.

targets.name: Little cream jug
targets.notes: A small cream ceramic jug with blue floral decoration sits inside the middle pantry basket. Its spout, rim, neck and complete loop handle remain visible; the wicker rim conceals the lower body. The preview preserves that natural overlap, and the reveal excludes the handle opening and basket.

targets.name: Metal flask
targets.notes: One brushed-metal flask leans diagonally inside the open picnic hamper. Its screw cap, dark collar and cylindrical body are clear. The checked cloth hides its lower left and the picnic wrapping overlaps its lower right; only the visible metal silhouette is traced.

targets.name: Blue floral tin
targets.notes: A cream rectangular biscuit tin decorated with blue flowers sits behind the open recipe book. Its fitted lid and patterned front remain recognizable; the contour follows the curved book overlap rather than inventing the hidden bottom of the tin. The name describes the blue flowers rather than implying a solid-blue body.

targets.name: Rolling pin
targets.notes: The wooden rolling pin lies diagonally among baking tins. The drawer front hides its lower handle; the barrel and upper handle remain clear.

targets.name: Flower tin
targets.notes: One flower-shaped baking tin sits in front of another mould. The scalloped rim and visible metal sides identify it; the drawer front hides the bottom.

targets.name: Floral milk jug
targets.notes: A tall cream milk jug with blue floral decoration stands on the floor below the dresser, nestled beside the apple crate and potato basket. Its narrow neck, loop handle and painted front distinguish it from the little basket jug. The apple crate obscures the left edge; the reveal follows that visible boundary and excludes the handle opening.

review.notes: One scene-first original. Twelve actual objects chosen for clear identifying parts and more natural overlap than54. All unchanged source crops and manual visible contours inspected enlarged; meaningful handle/wire openings excluded. The pantry basket, drawer lip, recipe book, neighboring books and cloth hide parts without changing reference appearance. Physical iPhone and player assessment pending.
